AI is an Armageddon level threat, far more ominous than any pandemic or climate crisis. Dems love AI. They’re weaponizing it. 

I’m introducing legislation forbidding the federal government from using Artificial Intelligence as a tool to enforce laws, regulations and codes. https://t.co/qsryx2y5fn

AI is an Armageddon level threat, far more ominous than any alleged pandemic or climate crisis. [...] I'm introducing legislation forbidding the federal government from using Artificial Intelligence as a tool to enforce laws, regulations and codes. Republicans will not allow government controlled AI computer programs to crawl around in the private business of free Americans.
AI does indeed offer capabilities that could serve mankind, but we must protect individual rights and freedoms of Americans. https://t.co/xPN1c9mePR

Are journalists using AI to write their articles?… Fascinating to reflect upon because journalism is a microcosm of our society. Some articles I’m reading are 100% disconnected from reality, yet they’re presented as thoughtful content. 
  
Loss of personal insight, sense of humor gone, poetic thought disappearing.

AI is being rapidly deployed throughout our federal government as a tool to enforce laws, regulations, and codes without regard to the severe risks. The authoritarian use of AI within our federal government to control and restrict the American people is nefarious in nature and carries major implications.
statements.venue: Press release on Oversight Committee markup, Higgins website

statements.text: The weaponization of AI technology is an ominous threat to our Constitutional freedoms. Unelected bureaucrats in DC should not be using AI as a tool to further weaponize the federal government against the American people. We, as a Congress who have been sworn to serve the people, must think seriously about the implications of the rapid deployment of AI technology.
statements.venue: Press release on No AI Audits Act, Higgins website

statements.text: AI can be a very powerful tool, but it should be effectively controlled. It cannot be allowed to run rampant over individual rights. Human beings must be in charge of government regulatory authority, not AI. https://t.co/q7dn5C26G4

statements.text:
Media: “Congressman Higgins, you’re a MAGA Republican, so why did you say that the No Kings rallies were a success?” 
Me: “Because we were carefully observing Ma’am. Liberals gathered predictably, weather cooperated, crowds were thin but they tended to linger and pose… it was pretty much a flawless operation. We have millions of digital images, billions of identifying data points. Height, weight, shoe size, tattoos, gait… all of it. AI eats that stuff. Success.”

Treasurer Fleming, Sir, I have thus far refrained from influencing the Louisiana U. S. Senate debate, because my longstanding policy has been to preserve a clear field for my fellow citizens, and encourage We the People to calmly assess the dynamics of every civic decision. 
  However… your representations, good Sir, for over a year, have been conducted in a particularly unseemly, ungentlemanly manner, and your current posture, of posting and supporting the obscenely disrespectful AI video of my colleague and friend Julia Letlow, mocking the tragic death of her beloved Husband, is beyond the pale of any Louisiana Gentleman. 
  I am compelled to insist, Mr. Treasurer, that you remove the post, divorce yourself from those who created the appalling video, and apologize to Ms. Letlow and her children. 
  Until Wednesday, at 1500 hours, I shall humbly await your decision. In that hour, I will either acknowledge your acquiescence, or I will step into the arena in chivalrous support of Ms. Letlow and her children, respectful of her deceased Husband Luke, whom I held dear. 
  I deliver this message publicly, because you have refused my private counsel. You’ve been led astray John. I’m advising you to set things right.

In America, public input should play a crucial role in shaping federal policy. As AI and other technologies advance, it is important that we preserve the integrity of constituent interactions. This legislation will ensure that Americans’ voices are not drowned out by automated content generated by bad actors.
statements.venue: Press release on Comment Integrity and Management Act, Higgins website
